entities.summary: Andrzej Zebrzydowski,, Radwan coat of arms, was a Polish Roman Catholic bishop of Kamieniec Podolski, Chełm, Włocławek and Kraków ; chaplain of Bona Sforza, then supporter of Sigismund II Augustus.
